request_payload.title: Trial of N-Acetyl-l-Leucine in Niemann-Pick Disease Type C.

mentions.sentence: We evaluated the safety and efficacy of N-acetyl-l-leucine (NALL), an agent that potentially ameliorates lysosomal and metabolic dysfunction, for the treatment of Niemann-Pick disease type C.
